name: veylo
description: A private space to capture and shape personal intentions

scripts.build: npm run build -w @veylo/domain && npm run build -w @veylo/db && npm run build -w @veylo/api && npm run build -w @veylo/worker && npm run build -w @veylo/web && npm run build -w @veylo/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @veylo/domain && npm run typecheck -w @veylo/db && npm run typecheck -w @veylo/api && npm run typecheck -w @veylo/worker && npm run typecheck -w @veylo/web && npm run typecheck -w @veylo/mobile
scripts.test:contracts: npm run test:ai-interpretation -w @veylo/api && npm run test:google-contract -w @veylo/api && npm run test:jira-contract -w @veylo/api && npm run test:notion-contract -w @veylo/api && npm run test:supabase-key -w @veylo/api && npm run test -w @veylo/worker && npm run test -w @veylo/mobile
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @veylo/domain && npm run build -w @veylo/db
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @veylo/domain && npm run dev -w @veylo/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @veylo/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @veylo/worker
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build -w @veylo/domain && npm run start -w @veylo/mobile
scripts.cloud:build:mobile:ios: npm run build -w @veylo/domain && npm run cloud:build:ios -w @veylo/mobile
scripts.cloud:build:mobile:android: npm run build -w @veylo/domain && npm run cloud:build:android -w @veylo/mobile
scripts.local:build:mobile:ios: npm run build -w @veylo/domain && npm run local:build:ios -w @veylo/mobile
scripts.local:build:mobile:android: npm run build -w @veylo/domain && npm run local:build:android -w @veylo/mobile
